verdict.rationale: Asana documents official client libraries for JavaScript and Python (asana-docs-32) and maintains a v3 Node SDK with a migration guide and pagination helpers (asana-docs-33). It also publishes an official OpenAPI spec repo for the REST API and app components (asana-supp-openapi-spec), which supports building against or generating typed clients. Missing for 10: official SDKs beyond JavaScript and Python, in-depth SDK documentation beyond the library list and Node migration notes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
